item.title: Tracy Scroggins, who had 60.5 sacks in 10 seasons for the Lions, dies at 56
item.description: Tracy Scroggins, who had 60.5 sacks in 10 seasons as a playmaking defensive end for the Detroit Lions, has died. He was 56.

item.title: Fight between Pistons and Hornets results in four players being ejected
item.description: A fight broke out between the Detroit Pistons and Charlotte Hornets in the third quarter of Monday night’s game, and four players were ejected.

item.title: Pistons snap Hornets’ 9-game win streak with 110-104 win in game marred by fight, ejections
item.description: Cade Cunningham had 33 points and nine rebounds, and the Detroit Pistons hung on to beat Charlotte 110-104 on Monday night, snapping the Hornets’ nine-game winning streak in a wild game that included a fight and four player ejections.

item.title: Photo gallery of Bloomfield Hills Cranbrook-Kingswood vs Riverview Gabriel Richard in a CHSL girls hoops battle
item.description: Monday was the first of two meetings between the Cranes and Pioneers scheduled for this week.

item.title: Gabriel Richard outlasts Cranbrook in key Catholic League girls hoops matchup
item.description: Big rallies in the middle quarters proved to be enough for the Pioneers to hang on vs the Cranes.

item.title: Photos of Clarkston vs. Stoney Creek in an OAA Red girls hoops contest
item.description: Clarkston got the better of Stoney Creek just a few days prior, but the Cougars scored some revenge with a 45-32 victory Monday night in Rochester Hills.

item.title: Stoney Creek avenges loss in Clarkston three days prior, beats Wolves 45-32
item.description: Stoney Creek lost in Clarkston last Friday, but the Cougars made amends for that defeat Monday night with a 45-32 home win over the Wolves.
